cmd.pickTarget: Select File or Folder to Compare…
config.allowOutsideWorkspace: Allow comparing files or folders outside the workspace. When disabled (default), the first access to a path outside the workspace asks once and remembers your answer.
config.exclude: Paths ignored during folder comparison (glob patterns, relative to the compared folder root).
config.maxFileSize: Maximum file size (MB) that takes part in the comparison. Larger files are not compared by content: folder comparison only compares their size, single file comparison shows a notice.
config.defaultViewMode: Default view mode used when opening a file.
config.mode.auto: Detect automatically (binary files open in the hexadecimal view)
